$BTC — Monday pattern deviation

"We de-correlated from a 10/10 pattern where $BTC has dropped an average of ~2% from the Monday high. Every single high was established on Monday (10/10 occurrences). But this time we're seeing a deviation... the algo is shifting."

Context: Continuation of Aug 17 Monday-pattern analysis series. Prior posts showed 11 consecutive Mondays with 1-2% drops. This week breaks the pattern — no Monday high formed; shifted to Tuesday instead. Validates structural evolution thesis KillaXBT has been tracking.
